This editorial illustration features a tan background framed by a vertical red stripe on the left and a horizontal red stripe at the bottom. At the top, the red word "TEMPO" is printed in large capital letters. Above it, black text reads "YANG LENYAP DI MUSEUM BAHARI" and "MENTERI BARU DEMI PEMILU." Below "TEMPO" is the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU."

The center displays the large black text "KISRUH IMPOR BERAS." A horizontal, textured gray-brown line cuts through the word "IMPOR." To the right, an illustration shows a man in a white long-sleeved shirt and dark pants sitting on a wooden plow pulled by two brown water buffaloes. The man holds a thin, curved whip above his head. The buffaloes are walking to the right, their bodies slightly overlapping. 

Below the main title, black text states, "KEPUTUSAN PEMERINTAH MEMBUKA KERAN IMPOR BERAS JADI PRO-KONTRA. TERSEBAB DATA YANG SIMPANG-SIUR." The bottom right corner contains publication details for "22-28 JANUARI 2018," a price, a website, and a barcode.
